notes.title: In game instruction for Easy Mode
notes.notes:
Added an instruction for the Easy Mode in game.
It appears at the gameover screen after losing 3 times.

notes.title: Easy Mode
notes.notes:
I added the easy mode to the game for players who think it's too difficult

[b]It's a hidden feature, and I recommend not to use it unless you're really stuck[/b]

You can access it by pressing the 7 key on your keyboard (not the 7 key on your numpad) 10 times
It'll play a sound effect, and the easy mode will be enabled
It'll also disable Steam Achievements
This setting won't be saved, so you need to do it again to enable it if you close the game
